episodes.title: Fingerprint
episodes.summary: In 1865 two young adventurers, Anna Wetherell and Emery Staines, meet on the last day of their voyage to New Zealand.

episodes.title: The Place You Return
episodes.summary: Lydia and Carver hatch a plan to free Carver from his convict past. Emery sets sail to the goldfields in search of Anna. Meanwhile, in 1866, the results of Crosbie Wells' autopsy are revealed.

episodes.title: Leverage
episodes.summary: Anna's suspicions are aroused as Lydia prepares to host a party. Lauderback is blackmailed. In 1866, Crosbie Wells is buried.

episodes.title: The Other Half
episodes.summary: In 1865, Emery and Anna have a disastrous reunion in Hokitika, Emery learns about Carver's past and Quee makes a rewarding discovery. In 1866, hope is fading for Anna - in desperation she takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Paradox
episodes.summary: A stranger arrives in town and interrupts a secret council between the men of Hokitika. The events from the night Crosbie Wells died are pieced together.

episodes.title: The Old Moon in the Young Moon's Arms
episodes.summary: Anna is tried for murder. New evidence reveals a connection between Lauderback and Crosbie Wells.
